name: Platinum Vape Disposable | Bacio Berry
description:
Bold. Creamy. Bursting with flavor.

Bacio Berry blends rich gelato cream notes with juicy mixed berries for a smooth, dessert-style hit that’s pure satisfaction from start to finish. This hybrid distillate delivers a balanced high — euphoric, relaxed, and perfectly chill — ideal for any time you want flavor and vibes in one pull.

Crafted with Platinum’s signature distillate and built into a rechargeable 2G all-in-one, you’ll get consistent clouds, clean taste, and full flavor in every session.

Flavor Profile: Berry • Creamy • Sweet

Effect: Euphoric • Balanced • Relaxed

Device: Rechargeable 2G Distillate Disposable • All-In-One • Dual Coil Design
